lines.text: As his death drew near, David charged Solomon to be strong and walk in the LORD's ways.
David said the LORD had promised that if his descendants walked faithfully, a man of his line would always sit on Israel's throne.
David told Solomon that Joab had killed Abner and Amasa, so Solomon should not let Joab die in peace.
David told Solomon to show loving devotion to Barzillai's sons, who stood by him when he fled from Saul, and to bring Shimei down to Sheol in blood.
David was buried in the City of David after reigning forty years, seven in Jerusalem and thirty-three in Hebron, and Solomon took the throne.
